book.totem.vanilla_tweaks_manual.title: Vanilla Tweaks Method Guide
book.totem.vanilla_tweaks_manual.page.1:
INVENTORIES

Hover the player or container side of an open menu and press the Sort Backpack key (middle mouse by default). The server validates the target.
book.totem.vanilla_tweaks_manual.page.2:
WORLD

Lecterns use four slabs and one book. Bookshelves become Chiseled Bookshelves; wet Concrete Powder hardens, and hopper-smelted output releases recipe XP.
book.totem.vanilla_tweaks_manual.page.3:
SKELETON QUIVERS

Base reserves are Easy 3–5, Normal 5–8, Hard 8–12. Normal rolls up to 2 extra arrows and Hard up to 4; each extra arrow uses vanilla local difficulty's special multiplier as its chance, so mature regions top out around 3–5, 7–10, and 12–16. Arrows are collectible and empty archers switch to melee. See Enchanting for target changes.
